node.label: Gallop rhythm
node.definition: In the normal heart cycle, two heart sounds can be heard by auscultation per cycle: S1 and S2. A gallop rhythm refers to the presence of three or four heart sounds per cardiac cycle, which is said to resemble the gallop of a horse.

evidence.snippet: Congenital heart block: Gallop rhythm (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
